tei:div.tei:p: 249) chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi cha lag cho ga spyi'i mtshams sbyor bsdus pa dngos grub bum bzang bzhugs: 250) na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye:

rang rig rtsa gsum lha la 'dud: gsang chen rim gnyis lam 'jug phyi rabs don: cho ga spros bcas kun la gces pa yi: mtshams sbyor dngos grub bum bzang 'di ru bstan: sa ma ya: spros bcas cho ga'i gzhung bzhin du: dkyil 'khor rdzas dang yo byad sogs: mkho ba'i sta gon legs par bsags: dam pa gsum gyis rang rgyud sbyangs: de nas gsang chu byin rlabs ni: oṃ swa bhā wa= haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las bsangs chu'i steng du pad nyi'i gdan la hūṃ yongs su gyur pa las khro bo bgegs mthar byed sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 251)ral gri dag g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa: spyan gsum dmar la zlum pa: zhal gdangs khro gnyer sdud cing mche ba rno dbal gtsigs pa: dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'khyil zhing dpal dang dur khrod kyi chas rdzogs pa: zhabs gnyis gyad stabs su bzhugs shing yum khro mo rlung 'byin ma skur 'khril ba: ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ ljang sngon gyi mthar rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od 'phros pas sku gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa thams cad tshur 'dus sngags phreng la thim pas gnyis su med par 252)gyur par bsam: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta utta ka hūm̐ phaṭa: ci nus bzlas mthar: lha de nyid 'od du zhu nas bsang chu la thim pas mchod rdzas kyi 'bags btsog dri ma nyes skyon thams cad dag byed kyi nus pa dang ldan cing mchod rdzas rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du bsgyur zhing mchod rdzas la 'tshe ba'i rigs rnams sreg cing brlag pa'i nus byin dang ldan par gyur: oṃ a bighān ta kritta hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa: khaṃ spha ra ṇa phaṭa: saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: de nas mchod rdzas byin brlabs ni: oṃ badzra aṛ ta= oṃ swa bha wa= mchod rdzas rnams kyi dngos 'dzin dri ma dang bcas pa thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur:

stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam par rol pa mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: oṃ su ra su ra a warta ya a warta ya hoḥ spha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā: oṃ badzra arghaṃ= shapda ru pa shapda= dharma pra tītstsha ye swā hā: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ye swā hā: ma hā ba liṃ ta ye 253)swā hā: ma hā rakta ye swā hā: ma hā sarba pū dza sa ma ya hoḥ de nas spos byung gi dud pas bdug sal: oṃ āḥhūm̐: ngo bo sku gsum ye shes kyi rol pa la rnam pa 'od lnga'i sprin phung bzang shing la thim pa'i dud sprin gyis ma rig gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi dri ma nyes skyon thams cad sbyang zhing dag pa dang: sku gsum rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams mnyes pa'i mchod sprin nam mkha' gang bar bsam: shuddhe bi shuddhe sang sang nge ye swā hā: badzra dhu pe pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐: de nas skyabs yul bskyed pa ni: oṃ ma hā shu n+ya tā= haṃḥ ma dag pa'i dngos 'dzin thams cad stong par sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba bzhin du skad cig gis mdun gyi nam mkhar padma dang nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bla ma dang gnyis su med pa cham me'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ma lus shing lus pa med pas bskor nas rang cag la zhal gyis phyogs: spyan gyis gzigs: thugs brtse ba chen pos dgongs nas bzhugs par gsal ba'i gnas gsum 254)las 'od 'phros pas sku gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs la bstim mo: de nas tshogs zhing bsdu ba ni: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ tshogs zhing rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par gyur:

de nas dkar gtor byin rlabs ni: oṃ swa bhā wa= sogs: stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod du dkar gsum mngar gsum bdud rtsi'i tshogs kyis gang ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: oṃ a kā ro= sogs: de nas bgegs gtor byin brlab la: oṃ badzra a mṛ ta= sogs: oṃ swa bha wa= sogs: bgegs kyi gtor ma 'dod dgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa nam mkha' mtha' klas par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: de nas byin chen dbab pa la: rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis sku gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul zhing thugs rje byin rlabs gzi byin nus pa dbang dang dngos grub thams cad 'od phung kha dog lnga'i rnam par byung nas gnas dang sgrub khang sgrub rdzas bdag mdun rnams la mtsho la kha char babs pa ltar sib sib thim par bsam: gzhan yang sku phyag rgya phra mo: gsung yig 'bru sna tshogs: thugs phyag mtshan la 255)sogs pa'i dbang byin dngos grub thams cad bdag dang sgrub rdzas dkyil 'khor rnams la thim pas snang srid dag pa rab 'byams kyi rol par byin gyis brlabs par gyur: de nas dbang bskur rgyal gdab la: rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis bde gshegs rigs lnga'i lha tshogs spyan drangs nas bum chus dbang bskur bas lus gang: nyon shes kyi sgrib pa dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa dang: phung po khams dang skye mched thams cad lha dang lha mo'i rang bzhin du gyur nas 'gyur ba med pa'i rgyas gdab par bsam moḥ rdo rje rtse gcig gi rgya gnas gsum du gtug bzhin: oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badzra swa bha wa atma ko3haṃ: de bzhin du: wākka= tsitta= thog mtha' sbyar: zhes brjod pas rgyal ba rnams kyi rgyal tshab tu dbang thob cing sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lor yongs su rdzogs par gyur:

de nas spyan 'dren la: rang nyid lha'i thugs srog sa bon las 'od 'phros pas bde gshegs rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad yi dam gyi lha mchog che ge mo'i rnam par chos kyi dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te bdag dang sgrub rdzas rnams la mtsho la kha char babs pa ltar sib sib thim par 256)gyur: rtsa sngags mthar: badzra sa ma ya dza dza st+wam: de nas sman mchod ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos sku kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen dang: rigs lnga mngon rdzogs bcom ldan rdo rje sems: rgyal ba dgongs brgyud bla ma thams cad la: gsang mchod bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la khā hi: rig 'dzin chen po dga' rab rdo rje dang: shrī sing ha paṇa chen bī ma la: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen padma 'byung gnas sogs: brda brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams la: gsang mchod= bzhes nas dbang= ma hā sarba= chos rgyal yab sras bai re g.yu sgra snying: mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: zhi ba mtsho dang 'bangs rigs nyer lnga sogs: snyan brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams la: gsang mchod= bzhes nas= ma hā sarba= zab gter mnga' bdag gter chen brgya rtsa dang: bdud 'joms rdo rje 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rjeḥ rigs kun yongs 'dus padma las 'brel rtsal: bka' babs rig 'dzin bla ma'i tshogs rnams la: gsang mchod= bzhes nas= ma hā sarba= theg dgu'i yi dam zhi dang khro bo'i lha: bka' dgongs phur 257)sogs bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang: ma hā ma ya la sogs yi dam lhar: gsang mchod= bzhes nas= ma hā sarba= gnas chen nyer bzhi yul ni sum cu dang: dud khrod brgyad dang he ru'i gnas bcu sogs: sku gsum zhing khams rab 'byams thams cad na: bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma tshogs la: gsang mchod= bzhes nas= ma hā sarba= dbyings kyi rje mo gza' mchog rā hu la: dam can rdor legs gnod sbyin shan pa che:

tshe ring mched lnga rdo rje g.yu sgron sogs: 'jig 'das dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams la: gsang mchod= bzhes nas= ma hā sarba= de ltar lha tshogs mnyes pa'i mthu byin las: rim gnyis dngos grub 'od lnga'i rnam pa ru: rnal 'byor sgo gsum bum pa snod du bskyil: zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes: rtsa sngags kā ya siddhi oṃ: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐: de nas phreng ba byin brlab la: oṃ swa bha wa= haṃ: phreng ba mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las rang gi lag gnyis padma kha sbyor gyi dbus stong du mdo 'dzin dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phreng dog rnams 'khor gyi rnam par gsal 258)ba'i ye shes 'od zer gyi thag pas 'brel ba las 'od 'phros pas sku gsum zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs te phreng ba lhar gsal ba la gnyis su med par thim par gyur: rtsa sngags dang: gu ru dhe wa ḍā ki ni sarba sa ma ya dza dza a bhi ṣiñtsa st+wam̐: zhes dang: dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum brjod mthar: oṃ ru tsi ra marni pra wardha na ye swā hāḥ nyer gcig mthar: oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: sa me tog 'thor mthar: de ltar phreng ba lhar gsal ba rnams kyi skus gar mdzad cing zhal nas sngags kyi sgra 'ur dir gyis sgrog par bsam la: de nas thun skabs 'dod gsol ni: shānti puṣṭiṃ wa shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: rtsa gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad 'grub par gyur cig: oṃ a ā= sogs dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying lan gsum mthar: che ge mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la thugs mkhyen pa'i ye shes: brtse ba'i thugs rje: mdzad pa'i phrin las: skyob pa'i nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' bas: bdag cag rnal 'byor sgrub pa po la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa da lta nyid du stsol bar mdzad du gsol:

de nas chos skyong gi gtor 259) ma byin brlab ni: oṃ swa bha wa= haṃ: stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma rnams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha'i ri bo khrag gi rgya mtsho dkar gsum dang mngar gsum brten rdzas dang bsgrub rdzas bskang rdzas la sogs pa 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam rol ltar rgyas par gyur cig: sngags drug phyag drug gis brlabs: de nas tshogs zhus la: hoḥ gsang chen dkyil 'khor 'dir bzhugs rdo rje slob dpon gyis gtsos rdo rje'i mched dang lcam dral 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol: longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa byin gyis rlob pa la thugs gtad par zhu: de nas bskang rdzas byin brlab ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bskang rdzas rnams dwangs shing yid du 'ong ba bkod legs pa 'dod dgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa rgya che la grangs mang ba 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i rnam rol du nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: nam mkha' mdzod sngags lan gsum mthar mchod pa'i sprin gzungs kyis brlabs: de nas bsgral ba la: gtor snod gru gsum 'bar ba'i hom du tshogs 260)rdzas dgra bgegs dngos su gsal bar dmigs: na mo:dkon mchog gsum dang sku gsum rtsa gsum dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyi bden pas gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad zhal zas tshogs kyi tha ma dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig: lan gsum: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ 'gugs bstim bsgral nas bstab par bya: de nas lhag ma byin brlab la: a mṛ ta sa bsangs: swa bha wa la sbyangs: stong par gyur: stong pa'i ngang las lhag gtor 'dod dgu'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs pa zad mi shes par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ oṃ a ka ro= sogs: swā hāḥ de nas bskul gtor la: e las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag la gting zab pa'i nang du gtor ma de nyid gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur:

na mo: rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam rnam dang*/ yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi bden pas dgregs gnod byed kyi rigs su gyur pa thams cad sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di la khug cig: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ de nas chad tho maḥ gong ltar 'gugs gzhug mthar: bdag mdun gyi sku las thun mtshon sna tshogs 'phros pas dgregs rnams rang dbang med par bla yid dang bral te gzugs phung de nyid 261)sha ri khrag gi rgya mtshos yongs su gang ste: ngo bo bde stong zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum gyis brlabs: de nas bstan ma la: bshal chu gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: lan gsum: bro mnan skabs: na moḥ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang: chos kyi bka' bden pa dang: dge 'dun gyi= bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa'i bka'= chos nyid gdod nas dag cing chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bka'= rnal 'byor sgrub pa po'i lha sngags ting nge 'dzin gyi mthu byin nus pa la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa dang: dge 'dun gyi sde bcom pa: gtsug lag khang dang dgon sde rnams kyi dkor cha 'phrog pa: rnal 'byor yongs la 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra: gzugs med kyi bgegs: tshe len gyi bdud: bar chad byed pa'i dam sri la sogs pa mdor na chos byang chub sgrub pa la bar du gcod par byed pa thams cad skad cig rang dbang med par gtor gzhong ri rab 'bar ba'i 'og rol du sa rim pa dgu'i 262)mar zhabs las kyi gshin rje nag po'i lto bar khug cig: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ gsum gyi mthar: gnod byed de dag 'od nag gi mun pas 'thu mas te brgyal bar bsam: de nas gtor snod kha yar btegs la:

gtor snod kha yar bstan pas bdag cag rnams kyi tshe bsod dpal yon thams cad gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par gyur cig: sarba bhrūm̐ a yu puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hāḥ de nas mchod pa'i skabs: bdag mdun gyi thugs las sprul pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas lha tshogs rnams kyi thugs mnyes shing tshim pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa spel bas thugs bde stong gi ros tshims nas mthu stobs nus byin dpag tu med pa ru 'phel zhing rgyas par bsam: bstod pa'i skabs: sprul ba'i lha mo rnams kyis rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la bstod pa glu'i mchod pa 'bul bar bsam la: mthar: lha mo rnams bdag gi thugs kar thim pas mthu dang nus pa byin rlabs dbang dang dngos grub bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par gyur: de nas bkra shis la: rang gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas chos kyi dbyings las 263)gzugs kyi skur bzhengs te bkra shis pa'i bden tshig brjod cing phyag nas me tog sna tshogs char du bsnyil bar gyur: oṃ ye dharmā=

sogs nas/ bkra shis ci rigs brjod par bya'o: e ma: de ltar rim gnyis brtson pa'i phyi rabs don: rtsa gsum 'jug chos dngos grub bum bzang 'di: mi 'gyur gsang ba'i gab sgrom nyid du sbos: ma 'ongs las 'phro can dang 'phrad par smon: bka' srung dregs pa'i tshogs kyi thub par srungs: dus la babs tshe chos 'di'i gtad rgya khrol: las can bu lnga'i dpal du spyod par nges: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang dus ring mo nas brda don gsal yang gab 'khrugs che ba dang*/ min kyang 7skyabs rje gong ma gnyis kyi zab gter gyi phyag bzhes la gnod kyi dogs nas btang snyoms su bzhag kyang rang gi nye gnas yi ge'i 'du byed shākya'i dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rjes yang yang nan cher bskul pa dang*/ rang slob dge btsun dam pa bya bral ba rig bzang dang*/ rang gi bu mo chos dbyings sgron ma sogs kyis yang yang bskul ngor ser dgon dben gnas mtshams khrod 'od gsal ljongs nas kun bzang chos nyid dbang mos nyams chos yig ris su bgyis pa'o/ de ltar gter min brdzun tshig sna tshogs 'di// 'bri 'dun med cing sems la dam bcas kyang*// shī la badzra nan chags che ba dang*/ 264) /rtsa khams 'khrugs pa'i lus gdon gyis non nas// mi bri thabs med rang dbang ma mchis kyang*// rang rgyud dug lngas bslad nas bris pa min// sbyor dngos rjes gsum rnam dag legs bsgrubs nas// phar phyin drug gi yan lag dang ldan cing*// yang dag gsang chen dkyil 'khor la zhugs pas// rdo rje'i mched grogs thugs bzhed skong phyir du// gter min gter gyi yig ris bris pa dge /zhes bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyis so//
